mechanistic_claim_tested: Accumulated HOG is exported to cytosol and cleaved by a non-HOGA1 aldolase to glyoxylate
key_finding: PH3 urine shows raised HOG/4-OH-Glu/DHG (GC-MS); detected a cytosolic HOG-aldolase activity in human hepatocyte lines not due to HOGA1
confidence_and_limitations: Seed reference. Activity detected but aldolase not identified; no flux quantification; small cohort

key_finding: Heterozygosity mapping in 15 patients/8 families identified DHDPSL mutations; assumed to encode HOG aldolase, final hydroxyproline step
confidence_and_limitations: Establishes gene; downstream oxalate mechanism not resolved

key_finding: Initially hypothesized gain-of-function HOGA activity; data instead support loss-of-function; PH3 urine oxalate lower, Ca/uric acid higher than PH1/PH2; eGFR preserved
disease_subtype_context: PH3 cohort + 100 idiopathic CaOx stone formers
confidence_and_limitations: Shows downstream mechanism historically unsettled; milder PH3 phenotype

mechanistic_claim_tested: HOGA catalytic mechanism and mitochondrial identity
key_finding: Purified hHOGA; 1.97A crystal structure w/ pyruvate; type I retro-aldol mechanism; Lys196 nucleophile
confidence_and_limitations: Establishes normal enzyme; does not address cytosolic cleavage

mechanistic_claim_tested: HOGA1 loss raises oxalate via decreased pyruvate / Krebs flux
key_finding: hHOGA1 has dual aldolase + oxaloacetate decarboxylase activity; pyruvate competitive inhibitor; propose loss lowers pyruvate availability/Krebs flux
confidence_and_limitations: Alternative to cytosolic cleavage; proposed not demonstrated by flux

mechanistic_claim_tested: Identity of cytosolic aldolase; HOG inhibits glyoxylate reductase
key_finding: All 9 PH3 HOGA variants unstable/inactive; HOG builds up in urine/sera/liver; NAL only minimal HOG cleavage; HOG inhibits GR (not 2-HG/2-OG)
confidence_and_limitations: Strong: rules out NAL candidate; GR-inhibition is parsimonious competitor; GR inhibition not shown in vivo

mechanistic_claim_tested: HOGA1 loss causes hyperoxaluria in vivo
key_finding: Hoga1-null mice accumulate HOG/4-OH-Glu/DHG but show NO increased oxalate excretion; notes low human penetrance
confidence_and_limitations: Core phenotype not reproduced; limits in vivo testability

mechanistic_claim_tested: Subcellular site of residual HOG->glyoxylate cleavage
key_finding: In Hoga1-KO mouse, residual HOG->glyoxylate aldolase activity highest in liver MITOPLASTS (not cytosol); cytosol favors NADPH-dependent HOG->DHG reduction
confidence_and_limitations: Residual aldolase mitochondrial, not cytosolic; tension with seed localization; enzymes unidentified; mouse context

mechanistic_claim_tested: Why mouse lacks hyperoxaluria; compartmentalized AGT
key_finding: Hoga1-/- mice lack increased urinary oxalate; Hoga1-/-/Agxt-/- with AGT only peroxisomal (human-like) STILL no hyperoxaluria; mito-AGT not the explanation
confidence_and_limitations: Refutes mito-AGT rescue explanation; model still fails to recapitulate PH3

mechanistic_claim_tested: Terminal step is hepatic-LDH-limited; oxalate source is hepatic
key_finding: Nedosiran (LDH RNAi) lowers urinary oxalate in PH1 but NOT PH2/PH3; glyoxylate/oxalate metabolism is multi-organ, not liver-confined
confidence_and_limitations: Review-level; challenges hepatocyte-centric terminal step of seed model
